title: Pretty Pink Stripes
text: Pretty Pink Stripes. This towel is cute. I really like the pretty pink stripes. It's not a plush beach towel by any means, but it's not one of those super thin ones either. The size is fine and as expected. I wouldn't have bought this if I had been able to touch and feel it first because I prefer thicker, plush towels. This is the kind of the towel that I would send with my kids to camp because I wouldn't care if something happened to it. It's just okay in my opinion.

description: The J & M Home Fashions Cabana Beach Towel is fun in the sun 100% cotton 32"x 64" multi-color stripe beach towel. With the woven yarn dyed rich colors, this is perfect for summers along sandy shores, sitting by the pool, out at the lake, or anywhere in between. These lively, bright, and colorful cabana towels are eye-catching and sure to draw compliments from your friends and family. These machine washable, easy care beach towels are very absorbent and will remain soft after multiple wash and dry cycles. Use these towels at the gym, lay over a hot lounge chair, sunbathe on the sand, or dry off after a dip in the water. The perfect towel for any outdoor activity! Available in 4 colors: Blue, orange, and pink.

details.Product Care Instructions: Machine Wash Cold, Dark Colors to be washed separately, Do Not Bleach, Tumble Dry Low Heat, Warm Iron, if needed.
